stress.note: Poisoned recycle, complete decoded field/content checks, one real Worker and Logger. Finite stress is empirical evidence, not universal proof; ASan/UBSan are not race detectors.

functional_normal.note: Real two-thread FIFO, 4096 active flow slots, four changing emissions/session, forced Logger startup pause, partial final cycle and poison-on-recycle. Empirical safety checks, not a proof for all schedules.

functional_asan.note: Real two-thread FIFO, 4096 active flow slots, four changing emissions/session, forced Logger startup pause, partial final cycle and poison-on-recycle. Empirical safety checks, not a proof for all schedules.
